## Appearance

Paul has a beautiful, boyish face of exquisite delicacy and refinement, paired with serious, dark blue eyes. Though he previously wore a mop of chestnut or brown curls, by the age of sixteen his hair has changed to close-cropped brown locks.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P27](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0027), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0029), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0030), +2 more_

## Personality

Paul Irving is an imaginative, genius, and fair-minded individual who maintains a sober, grave, and meditative demeanor. Recognized as a perfect little gentleman and clean in his habits, he is also manly and protective of younger students by organizing games and keeping older boys from meddling with them.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P32](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0032), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P52](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0052), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P3](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0003), +2 more_

## History

Paul Irving, a creative student who once wrote a composition about a moonshine boat, lost his mother three years prior to attending the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. On [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's first day of teaching, she formed a quick bond with Paul after he gave her flowers, and he soon became her favorite pupil. In his schoolwork, Paul shared his imaginative world of rock people and fantastical journeys to sunset lands. At the end of the school year, he visited the graveyard with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to discuss his mother's memory and his life living with his grandmother. After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) introduced Paul to Miss Lavendar, Paul conversed with her about their shared imaginary dream-people and later visited [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) as his father prepared to marry her.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P9](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0009), +24 more_

## Quotes

> "and I came back to give them to you because I thought you were the kind of lady that would like them, and because . . ."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021)

> “Yes; but if dryads are foolish they must take the consequences, just as if they were real people,” said Paul gravely. “Do you know what I think about the new moon, teacher? I think it is a little golden boat full of dreams.”
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P30](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0030)

> "I’ve eaten enough to make anyone grow. I do hope, now that I’ve begun, I’ll keep on till I’m as tall as father. He is six feet, you know, Miss Lavendar."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P24](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0024)

> "you can’t think what has happened! Something so splendid. Father is here . . . just think of that! Father is here! Come right in. Father, this is my beautiful teacher. You know, father."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021)

> "I think you would make a splendid mother. You have just the right look in your eyes . . . the look my little mother always had. I think it’s a pity you haven’t any boys of your own."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P58](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0058)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--paul-irving.md)

[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) is Paul's schoolteacher, and the two quickly become fast friends due to their shared imaginative nature. Paul opens up to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about his mother's memory, his life with his grandmother, and his inner thoughts, such as when he walks home with her or hosts her for tea. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) considers him a favorite pupil, visiting him when his grandmother is away and involving him in excursions to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), +12 more_

### [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/paul-irving--shirley.md)

[Shirley](../character/shirley.md) acts as Paul's teacher, and Paul is a dedicated student who is deeply fond of her. Their strong connection is evident from their very first day in the classroom, where Paul presents her with flowers and writes imaginative compositions that [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) admires as her favorite pupil's work. Outside of school, Paul accompanies [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) on walks to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), visiting Miss Lavendar together and sharing tender moments regarding their imaginative worlds.
